about: The trip map on the ticket sheet (docs/station-feature-decision.md -> Board, map, city). The picture is one painted map of Italy with no cities on it (image id travel/map, public/images/travel/map.jpg); each city's building is its own picture (travel/building-<city id>), shown on the departures board. Here: the picture's width divided by its height, each city's spot on the picture as fractions from the top left (x across, y down; measured on the picture, 2026-11-11), and the cities whose names always show for orientation. No cities listed means the country has no map yet: the ticket sheet shows the ticket alone.
